statement: Israeli air, drone, or artillery strikes inside Gaza City occur between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-24.
resolution: True if Al Jazeera and BBC World each report an Israeli air, drone, or artillery strike inside Gaza City occurring between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-24.
failure_condition: No Israeli strike inside Gaza City occurs during the window.

statement: Russia's Ministry of Defence claims 100 or more Ukrainian drones destroyed or intercepted over a single night between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-24.
resolution: True if Russia's Ministry of Defence publicly claims destroying or intercepting 100 or more Ukrainian drones over one overnight period between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-24, per wire reporting.
failure_condition: No single-night MoD claim reaches 100 drones during the window.

statement: Front-month Brent crude settles at or below 75.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: True if front-month Brent futures post a settlement price at or below 75.00 US dollars per barrel on any trading day between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: Every Brent front-month settlement in the window prints above 75.00 US dollars.

statement: AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb announce a definitive merger or acquisition agreement between 2026-08-10 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: True if AstraZeneca or Bristol Myers Squibb issues a press release or regulatory filing confirming a definitive merger or acquisition agreement between the two companies, dated within the window.
failure_condition: No definitive agreement between the two companies is executed during the window.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range at a scheduled meeting held between 2026-08-10 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: True if an FOMC statement issued at a scheduled meeting within the window announces an increase to the federal funds target range.
failure_condition: The target range is held or cut at every scheduled meeting in the window.

statement: CISA adds a CVE affecting N-able N-central to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog contains an entry for a CVE in N-able N-central carrying a date-added value between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: No N-able N-central CVE receives a KEV date-added value inside the window.

statement: The UK Information Commissioners Office confirms a formal investigation or enforcement action over the PNLD breach between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: True if the ICO publishes a statement, case page, or enforcement notice confirming formal investigation or enforcement action regarding the PNLD breach, dated within the window.
failure_condition: The ICO opens no formal investigation or enforcement action on PNLD in the window.

statement: The US Senate confirms Todd Blanche as Attorney General between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: True if the Senate roll call record shows a confirmation vote approving Todd Blanche as Attorney General on a date between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: No successful Senate confirmation vote on Blanche occurs within the window.

statement: The National Interagency Fire Center posts National Preparedness Level 5 on at least one day between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-15.
resolution: True if an NIFC daily situation report dated between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-15 states National Preparedness Level 5.
failure_condition: NIFC preparedness level stays at 4 or lower every day of the window.

statement: US and Iranian officials hold a confirmed direct bilateral meeting between 2026-08-10 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: True if the US State Department and Iran's foreign ministry both confirm a direct bilateral meeting between US and Iranian officials held within the window.
failure_condition: No direct US-Iran bilateral meeting occurs in the window, mediated contact only.
